# dremio_role_membership (Resource)

One explicit role assignment in the experimental OSS RBAC fork. Uses stable IDs, not names. An active ADMIN is required. PUBLIC is implicit and cannot be managed. Server rejects role cycles and removal of the last active ADMIN. Existing assignments must be imported; grants and other memberships are never replaced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Existing local-user profile is adopted by its stable UID separately.
# The role must be managed or imported; this does not create an account.
resource "dremio_role_membership" "reader" {
  role_id     = dremio_role.read_only.id
  member_type = "USER"
  member_id   = dremio_user.reader.id
}

# Nested assignment: analyst receives read_only privileges, not vice versa.
resource "dremio_role_membership" "analyst_reads" {
  role_id     = dremio_role.read_only.id
  member_type = "ROLE"
  member_id   = dremio_role.analyst.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String) Stable user UID or member role ID; never a display name.
- `member_type` (String) USER or ROLE. For ROLE, the member role receives privileges of role_id.
- `role_id` (String) Stable ID of the role being granted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical base64url (without padding) of the compact JSON array [role_id, member_type, member_id]. Import by this key.
- `tag` (String) Observed global policy OCC version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Canonical base64url without padding of compact JSON [role_id, member_type, member_id].
# A resource's computed id is this key; importing never resolves display names.
tofu import dremio_role_membership.reader '<canonical-membership-key>'
```
